name: dot-pattern
blurb: SVG grid of dots that optionally glows with random pulsing.
description: Responsive dot pattern rendered as SVG circles that fill the container. Optional glow mode adds opacity and scale animations to each dot with randomized delay and duration.
use_when: A subtle, adaptable dot grid background that can be static or gently animated with configurable spacing.
avoid_when: Very dense grids on low-end devices — calculating and rendering many dots may cause performance issues.
a11y: Marked aria-hidden with pointer-events-none; purely decorative overlay. Glow animation has no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
